title: A Projection Method for an Elasto-plasticity Model with Linear Kinematic Hardening
summary: We consider a dynamical elasto-plasticity system with Kelvin--Voigt viscosity and linear kinematic hardening of Melan--Prager type. The model is formulated in a variational framework in which a constraint set for the stress evolves in time and is translated by an internal (backstress) variable. As a consequence, the flow rule is coupled with an equation of motion through a quasi-variational structure, since the constraint set depends on the unknown internal variable.
